title: CS156 Pipeline 3 — "From Compression to Generation"
summary: A personal machine-learning pipeline that models one person's movie-taste ratings through 14-15 methods (HMM, Kalman filters, GNNs, causal matching, VAEs) culminating in an AI-generated ideal movie trailer. The requirements list sdv>=1.10 and a script named 15_tvae_synth.py generates 'rare-taste' synthetic training samples, but no actual SDV import or call site was found in the harvested code, so SDV's TVAE synthesizer is only nominally referenced.
evidence: requirements.txt: sdv>=1.10; scripts/15_tvae_synth.py # TVAE rare-taste synthesis (no matching code call found)
needs: No pattern hits in code confirm whether 15_tvae_synth.py actually calls sdv's TVAEsynthesizer or a custom src/tvae.py implementation; cannot verify actual SDV usage from this evidence.
